definitions: Spoken by a player during a match with one or more visually impaired players to indicate the b-file in algebraic notation.
A female given name from Italian.

blocks.text: Bella is a feminine given name. It is a diminutive or nickname form of names ending in -bella, including Izabella and Isabella. However, it can also derive, unrelatedly, from the Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and (ultimately) Latin words for "beautiful". In French, Belle is a name and word meaning beautiful.
